job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services published in 2022?
job.acceptance: Accept date/time/Hawaii Standard Time equivalents. Issue date, RFP number and later best-and-final deadline are optional context.

reviews.reason: The document is a 2023 Oklahoma OPERS RFP for index investment management services, not the 2022 Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services. Its proposal deadline does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: THE OKLAHOMA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES RETIREMENT SYSTEM REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL #515-24-001 U.S. EQUITY, Non-U.S. EQUITY, AND FIXED INCOME (TIPS) INDEX INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT SERVICES
OPERS RFP – Investment Management Services – Issued July 20, 2023 Page 1 of 17
The deadline for receipt of proposals is 4:30 p.m. Central Time, on August 11, 2023.
